title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Check the digits of five real products at home
body:
## Problem
Session 1 uses example numbers only. A real product makes the check digit feel real.

## Context
The experiment in Session 1, Section E asks learners to try a packaged product.

## Expected outcome
A short table of five products (name type only, no brand needed), their 13 digits and whether each passes `ean13_is_valid`, plus one sentence on what you learned.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Five numbers checked
- [ ] Any failure is explained (misread digit, EAN-8 or UPC-A format)

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Hamming(15,11) to Session 2
body:
## Problem
Session 2 mentions Hamming(15,11) but only builds Hamming(7,4).

## Context
The rate graph shows (15,11) has rate 0.733; learners should be able to build it.

## Expected outcome
Functions that build G and H for any r and a test that all single errors are repaired.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-02/checkpoint.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Works for r = 3, 4, 5
- [ ] Checkpoint added and `python start.py test` passes

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add a 2D blob damage model and measure it
body:
## Problem
Session 3 damages the code with random flips and a burst in reading order, but real stains are round.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 1: survive a coffee-stain blob.

## Expected outcome
A `blob_noise(grid, row, col, size)` function, a success table over all blob positions, and a figure.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Table over every placement of a 3 by 3 and a 4 by 4 blob
- [ ] Short explanation of why some placements fail

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a code that survives a stain
body:
## Problem
The Target animation repairs a scratched and stained toy code; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Repairs every 4 by 4 blob placement
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
